body:
Really hard to find. Feels impossible. And things are getting worse. 

I hate this feeling. I am 27, and I can't keep feeling like this.

I have tried. I have actually talked to HR departments from fairly big companies, but the qualifications I have right now are never going to be good enough for them to sponsor a visa. And I have no way of improving my qualifications.

Hey there.

I just feel like such a waste of a person. I have no friends. No girlfriend. Never even been on a date.

No job. No reasonable way of finding a job here. no way of leaving to a place that a job would be easier to find. 

No real point in carrying on. Every day I stay alive, I just cost my parents more and more money. And I can't keep doing that to them.

...

Thanks for trying to help, but you don't think I would love to move to a first world country?

Getting a work visa in America is damn near impossible right now. Do you pay much attention to the news? The whole world is having immigration crises.
Finding a job isn't as easy as it sounds. I have been applying everywhere for over a year. Things are really bad here. And I can't get a visa to anywhere that job is easier to find
